METHOD
PATH

businessRules: document=cnote requires type=variable. Nonzero pmc requires the PMC addon. Requires an active property with the expenses module.
lines is required and contains 1 to 20 lines within the 8192-byte body limit. The header and all lines are committed together; any line failure rolls back the complete creation.

uploadExpenseFile.name: uploadExpenseFile

apid.description: Property ID belonging to the authenticated account.

content_base64.description: Canonical Base64 of PDF, JPG, JPEG or PNG bytes, without whitespace or a data URI. The file type is detected from its content; no filename is supplied.

uploadExpenseFile.description: Attach or replace one expense document using a signed JSON upload; no URL downloads or QR processing.
businessRules: Maximum original file size is 5 MiB (5242880 bytes); the raw JSON ceiling is 7 MiB for this endpoint only. Other operations remain limited to 8192 bytes.
Verify expense/account/property ownership and the expenses module. Detect the initial file type from its bytes, then require security validation; unsupported or malformed documents are rejected.

PDF, JPG, JPEG and PNG files are sent to an external security service for Content Disarm and Reconstruction (CDR). Only the approved, reconstructed PDF/A is stored; images are accepted but the stored content type is always application/pdf.

Both the original and reconstructed file must fit within 5 MiB. Unsafe files are rejected; timeouts, service failures or incomplete security results reject the upload without storing the original or replacing the existing attachment.

No filename or content_type request parameter is accepted. Store privately under a server-generated name, without execution permissions. Replace the existing attachment only after successful processing.
Uploading an attachment does not parse QR codes, change expense lines/totals, or fetch a client URL.

Expense uploads share a validation-service rate limit of 1 call per second across all clients. Excess calls are queued for execution by the validation service rather than rejected immediately; sustained over-subscription increases latency. Hostkit adds no local waiting queue or automatic retry; validation requests have a 60-second timeout, including any provider-side waiting. When the validation service returns HTTP 429, the API responds with HTTP 503, code validation_unavailable and message "Expense uploads have a rate limit of 1 per second". Timeouts retain the generic validation-unavailable message. Failed uploads save no file and leave the existing attachment unchanged.

getCityTaxDeclarations.description: Read account city-tax declarations with their local PDF in document as base64 JSON, or null when no local PDF is available.
businessRules: Search both declaration sources for the authenticated account, including historical declarations. No apid or id is accepted or returned. source is a response field, not a request filter; uniqid searches both sources and remains the declaration identifier. All supplied filters intersect. Month and quarter are mutually exclusive and require year.
Validate source-specific periods and states. iTaxas keeps its stored numeric month when historical periodicity is unknown.

license_number matches one complete registration or an exact member of a comma-separated merged group, never a substring. Each stored merged declaration is returned as one object with the full license_number list; number, multibanco and document belong to the whole group. Payment amounts are not split between registrations. Never expose municipal credentials or internal error text.
Returns declarations, limit, offset and has_more. Each declaration contains document: {content_base64, content_type, filename} for an available local TMTAI PDF, otherwise null.

document_available is distinct from document_supported. Remote iTaxas documents are not fetched and token URLs are never returned. Invalid local PDF content returns invalid_document. Local files are bounded at 50 MiB; delivery additionally requires the page to fit 60 MiB of encoded document JSON, below the 64 MiB HTTP ceiling. An oversized page, including an individual PDF too large after Base64 encoding, returns HTTP 413 response_too_large. Filter by uniqid or use a smaller limit for multi-document pages.

Results always remain a paginated declarations array, including with uniqid. No matches return an empty array, not a not_found error. If a uniqid occurs in both sources, both account-owned records are returned.

Each declaration includes its saved number and multibanco: {entity, reference, amount}, or null when payment data is missing or malformed. Both declaration sources are supported. Entity and reference are strings preserving leading zeros; amount is a nonnegative decimal string with two decimal places and a dot separator.

source.description: Declaration source; part of its identity.

uniqid.description: Opaque declaration identity from the selected source.

license_number.description: Full saved registration number or comma-separated merged group.

number.description: Saved declaration number; empty when not yet assigned.

amount.description: Amount payable for the whole declaration, with two decimal places and a dot separator.

multibanco.description: Payment data for the whole declaration, or null when missing or malformed.

submitCityTaxDeclaration.name: submitCityTaxDeclaration

license_number.description: One numeric registration number configured in the authenticated account.

month.description: Declared month ("9" or "09") or quarter ("1T", "2T", "3T", "4T"); not the sending month.

submitCityTaxDeclaration.description: Submit a city-tax declaration for a completed period using the registration's existing agent configuration.
businessRules: Requires an existing, active city-tax agent and complete provider credentials. The API never creates or changes agent configuration. Monthly requests require configured period 1; quarterly requests require period 2. A mismatch returns HTTP 409 period_mismatch before submission.

The registration and every member of a merged declaration must belong to the authenticated account, have active properties and the city-tax module enabled. Conflicting providers or group configurations are rejected. No apid, source selector or municipal credentials are accepted.

The declared period must have ended. Calculations and configured grouping follow the application submission flow. Selecting a merged member submits the entire configured group, not a separate declaration.

Existing declarations for the registration/group and period return HTTP 409 declaration_exists. Another account submission in progress returns operation_in_progress. Do not run a manual application submission concurrently with this operation.

Returns the saved uniqid, source, license_number, year, month and status. submitted means accepted for processing; municipal submission can still be pending, and it does not mean paid or settled. Poll getCityTaxDeclarations using uniqid for the current declaration state.

An uncertain external or persistence outcome returns HTTP 503 citytax_submission_uncertain. A later attempt is blocked with submission_reconciliation_required until the outcome is reconciled. Never automatically repeat a submission after a timeout or uncertain response.

uniqid.description: Opaque declaration identity from the selected source.

source.description: Declaration source; part of its identity.

license_number.description: Registration number or the full configured merged group.

status.description: Submission accepted; read the declaration for subsequent state.

getUsers.name: getUsers

apid.description: Property ID belonging to the authenticated account.

getUsers.description: List service users of the authenticated account; exclude authentication data.
businessRules: username is an alternative email selector; reject conflicting identities. Returns users, limit, offset and has_more.

addUser.name: addUser

phone.description: Service contact phone; alternative to the top-level phone.

items.description: Assigned property ID belonging to this account.

property_ids.description: Explicit property assignments, replacing the account relationship only when supplied. All IDs require ownership checks.

calendar_reservations.description: Calendar permission: 0 none, 1 calendar, 2 calendar only.

addUser.description: Create a service user with explicit property assignments; no automatic invitation is sent.
businessRules: Validate property ownership and identity conflicts within the existing app rules. Existing administrator/service identities are rejected.
Missing permissions grant nothing. No password or administrator role is accepted. Account context comes only from authentication.
Use phone or contact, not both. Fiscal permissions must be managed in the application, not through this operation.
Only the authenticated account relationship may be changed. Confirm an uncertain write outcome before retrying.

updateUser.name: updateUser

phone.description: Service contact phone; alternative to the top-level phone.

items.description: Assigned property ID belonging to this account.

property_ids.description: Explicit property assignments, replacing the account relationship only when supplied. All IDs require ownership checks.

calendar_reservations.description: Calendar permission: 0 none, 1 calendar, 2 calendar only.

updateUser.description: Update the service user relationship identified by email; email itself cannot be changed.
businessRules: Require an editable field besides email. Omitted fields/permissions remain unchanged; a supplied property_ids replaces only this account assignment.
Use phone or contact, not both. Fiscal permissions stay managed in the application.
Shared-profile edits return conflict and must be managed in the app; account relationship permissions may be updated independently.
Validate every property. Never modify another account relationship or grant administrator access.
